module.summary: Tables I through VII show Food Stamp Program income standards, coupon allotment, standard deductions, maximum shelter/dependent-care deductions, utility and telephone allowances, and homeless shelter allowance. Table VIII shows AFDC gross income standards, consolidated need standards, standard payment amounts, and a $10 minimum AFDC payment.
